source_review.notes: Reviewed current official PostgreSQL page/file/TOAST/catalog/pageinspect documentation and buffer-manager source notes; current MySQL 8.4 InnoDB row-format documentation; official SQLite file-format documentation; ARIES; and the cited database textbook. Eight of nine online destinations returned HTTP 200. The current MySQL page was readable through the research index but returned automated-request HTTP 403. All vendor layouts are explicitly version/engine scoped.

Checked byte-relative field, tuple, page, block, segment, and file-offset scopes.
Checked distinctions among logical key, row version, physical record identifier, relation incarnation, fork, buffer frame, cached image, completed write, and durable image.
notation_and_syntax.notes: The teaching format is named at every quantitative use and is not represented as PostgreSQL, InnoDB, or SQLite.

conceptual_review.notes: The chapter composes the complete storage-block curriculum from typed catalog-bound values through records, pages, heaps, free-space selection, buffers, replacement, WAL-ordered writeback, checksums, physical files, and visibility-aware decoding.

pedagogical_review.notes: The one-page integration, exact ten-line executable trace, ten cross-layer failure examples, and five progressive exercises consolidate DBE-021 through DBE-029 and expose nonportable assumptions.

limitations: Internal authoring, official/primary-source, mathematical, bounded executable-model, conceptual, practitioner, and pedagogical evidence only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed.
